top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The admission forms used were outdated. The admission forms do not capture the required minimum standards changes of March 2023.

top_violation_types.title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation made changes to the outside playground area and did not notify Child Care Regulations, that the changes were completed. Children were observed playing on the new play equipment.   The operation did not notify Child Care Regulations that they were moving classrooms and using one room that was unlicensed space.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director attendance records were not available.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Water Safety training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(8)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Employees were lacking of water safety trainings during the inspection time.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers (26 TAC §746.1203(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The main caregiver in the classroom fail to communicate to the caregiver coming to take over the class that a child in the classroom had a food allergy and would not be able to eat the evening snack that is serviced.
